title: Registry kit and workspace indexes and source-change candidates accept the plain format with formatVersion
summary: registryKitIndex, registryWorkspaceIndex and sourceChangeCandidate accept the plain format names (registry-kit, registry-workspace, source-change) with formatVersion 1 as well as the original ia.registry-kit.v1, ia.registry-workspace.v1 and ia.source-change.v1 literals; the refined schemas stay strict objects whose shape and extend remain usable (.safeExtend() when replacing fields).
